Definition: Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings
BiblicalUsage: Jehoash = "given by the Lord"; 1) son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; 2) son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
